dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: Sisi, get back here! You're interfering with the Parade!

dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: Huh? You mean that there's no Flower Carriage or cats named Sisi here?

dialogues.speaker: Shapur
dialogues.text: Don't... Don't you lie to me just because I'm old! I clearly saw... Uh, when was that again?
